title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode4 What Lies Beyond My Choice

meta.Episode: Episode4 — What Lies Beyond My Choice
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The chorus towards the end is still bugging me. What if I added a pause going in? I can move the waveform like this and...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh no...!
What do I do?! It's starting to sound really funny again...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No, I can handle this...
As long as I do what Kanade just taught me, I can fix things one note at a time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And it sounds completely different overall now. I'm so glad I decided to ask Kanade for her advice...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm actually starting to run out of things to do... But this bit of the first verse is still kind of bothering me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This part is supposed to be about “courage”, which is why I made the guitar stand out a little. However, using the bass to produce a denser sound could also work.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hmm... Do I go with the guitar or a denser sound...? Which would be better?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (You know what...? For now, I'll try making both!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, that should do it.
I think it sounds much better now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry, Hoshino...
I became so focused after getting a good feeling about this song... How are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki? Ichika?
Mind if I come in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
How are things going for you two?
I poured some tea and made some rice balls if you'd like some.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, thank you. I think I'll have some as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sounds like you've both been hard at work in silence for several hours now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Again, Hoshino, I'm so sorry...
I became so lost in my own world that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
You taught me the basics, and my song's become so much better as a result.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It is, but...
A new problem just came up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm at a fork in the road for this one part...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I like the two ideas I've come up with, but don't know which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's sort of the problem with digital tools. You're not physically limited by which instruments are available to you, so there are a lot of different possibilities just for plugins alone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, that's very true...
In the beginning, I sort of couldn't believe that there were all these options just in terms of guitars.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I struggled with that at first too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. From start to finish, I had no idea which choices were right and which were wrong. And it wasn't just me. No one has the answers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sometimes faced with two choices like you right now, Hoshino. It takes some amount of courage to choose just one...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you can't complete your song if you don't, so I think you should be courageous, pick one and be confident in your decision.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's the other side of the coin. As hard as it can seem sometimes, the people who enjoy listening to your song may see how interesting it can be to use digital music tools.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-It is?
I didn't mean for it to sound so grandiose.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I experienced not too long ago a situation where I was faced with some tough choices...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel that having the courage to make a decision and feeling confident about it doesn't just apply to songwriting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So...
I'd like to take what you just said to heart.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Because I've also made the mistake of not making a clear decision at a crucial time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (When Saki was able to come back to school, I thought that the four of us would get to be close again like before, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I didn't know how to make that happen... And I ended up not doing anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I took a hard look at myself and came to a decision. I want to be with them, so...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree with what you're saying, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I need to have courage...
I need to be confident about my decision and move forward.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, after we've had some of Ms. Mochizuki's rice balls, let's get back to work.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...!
After I have some, I'll give my choices some more thought... And come to a decision!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. These have salmon in them and these are filled with cod roe. Please choose whichever ones you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Which to choose...
Salmon sounds good, but so does the cod roe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I don't think I can eat two... Hmm... I can't decide...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Haha...
Ichika, there's really no need to think so hard...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This is like another fork in the road...
I suppose it never is easy to decide which path to take.
